scheduledInvocations.prompt: Scheduled Housing release check + heartbeat. Follow your system prompt's cheap-path procedure: ReadDocument the blackboard (doc cmq5rqdws16qq06adoiw88r03) — it externalizes, so pass the returned file path to the Housing Release Check (FRED) skill via --blackboard-file and do NOT read the full doc into context. If any_new is false → only refresh the Housing 'Last checked' heartbeat ('<now ET> - no new release') and stop, NO Slack. If any_new is true → look up consensus for each new report, append the row, update Current stance, set the heartbeat to 'logged <report>', and post a concise #hyper-asset-monitoring (C0B8B76L7NH) alert. Never Slack on a no-new-release run; never log a release twice (reference-month dedup is authoritative).
